name: Perilous Strike
body:
School divination; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a platinum miniature archery target worth 100 gp)

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

This spell guides the caster’s claw (or other weapon) with supernatural knowledge. The next attack the caster makes during the duration that would miss its target gains a +20 bonus. If the caster strikes the target using this additional bonus, make a normal attack roll to confirm a critical as if you had threatened with a critical (whether you did or not). If you confirm the critical strike, resolve it as if you had really rolled a critical hit.

The spell affects only one attack and then ends.
